protocol.design: Five outer patient folds; three grouped inner folds select regression hyperparameters on30-minute training MAE;20% outer training patients are calibration-only.
protocol.target: exact native endpoint CGM; event: current<=180 and any native future CGM>180 within horizon
protocol.event_episode: first above180 native reading reachable from a below/equal180 eligible forecast; alert cooldown equals horizon; one onset matched at most once
protocol.alert_selection: Calibration-only maximum episode recall constrained to<=1 false alert per24 eligible forecast hours; threshold grid .02:.02:.98 plus1.01(abstain)
protocol.intervals: Separate-patient90th percentile absolute residual, fixed empirical widths; no distribution-free claim
protocol.probabilities: Separate-patient logistic calibration of raw classifier logits, C=1.0
protocol.primary_model_gate: hybrid only if30-minute paired patient-bootstrap95% CI upper bound<0; otherwise population, adaptation experimental
protocol.phase: First24h of each recording cold_start; subsequent origins adapted. State resets per recording.
protocol.context: Matched age/sex/BMI/duration, assumed available at baseline; untimed labs/medications excluded
protocol.evidence_boundary: Internal retrospective validation: patients and legacy evaluation already inspected. No external/prospective/clinical validation.

demo.curation_note: Retrospectively selected out-of-fold episode during the virtual weekday09-17 demonstration window, favoring a clear warning and close hybrid forecast. This selected case does not establish clinical effectiveness or actual historical staffing.

data_quality.note: Includes native-gap abstention and end-of-recording origins with unavailable future labels; not pure real-time abstention.

limitations: Internal retrospective validation; this entire public cohort and legacy split were inspected before this experiment.
No independent external, prospective, clinical, or Indian population validation.
Historical age/sex/BMI/duration are assumed available at baseline; untimed labs, medications, and outcomes excluded.
Empirical fixed intervals and calibrated probabilities need prospective reliability assessment; no unconditional coverage guarantee.
Alert thresholds were selected on calibration patients; test alert burden may exceed the calibration budget.
24 eligible hours means below/equal180 valid native forecast time, not all calendar time or a verified staffed clinic schedule.
Cold start is online adaptation during first24h, not zero-shot; state resets for every recording.
Twin is an engineering forecast model, not physiological metabolism, medication advice, or treatment simulation.
Fold-wise median warning lead times are aggregated as a median of fold medians; event confidence intervals remain future work.
Doctor operating-point and workflow review remains pending; frozen protocol is an engineering experiment, not clinical acceptance.
Demo staffing uses a labeled historical virtual local clock; source timezone and actual historical staffing are unverified.

runtime.note: Use a patient's outer evaluation fold at runtime; unseen imported patients use the demo-fold model and are out of distribution.
